I managed to get the FISP coupon this season, so I will apply the two bags of NPK and urea across my 0.64 hectare maize plot, which also has beans intercropped in it. I will also put manure that I collected from our goats on the field, and I will plant the hybrid seed that came with the coupon because it gives better yield than local maize. I will do most of the ridging, planting, and weeding with my family over about seventy days, and I will hire about twelve days of ganyu labor when the weeding is heavy, but I cannot afford chemicals or irrigation so I must rely on the rains.
